blends.name: Recycle Gratitude Rail Key - Get Land Shards
blends.desc:
Welcome to the Uplift World recycling program!

1) Burn one key. Warning, this means the key will be gone for good. You will permanently lose all access and rights, all structures etc. on the plot will vanish and it will return to its pre-built landscape state.

2) You will get a Land Shard Big Pack in return. This pack contains between 60 and 120 Land Shards. You can forge Land Shards into new Land Packs which contain a fresh new land.

Thanks for recycling!

blends.name: Londom World - Londomly Deck Blend
blends.desc:
This pack contains 1 random plot in the Uplift World metaverse. 

Decks are limited editions of plots in proximity to each other. The exact position within the deck area is random. You can determine the total number of plots by looking at the “max supply”. 

Decks can contain different types and sizes of land.

The key you will get when opening this pack is an NFT key that grants you control and building rights over a specific area. You will be able to participate in the in-game and rewards economy. Want to learn more? Visit https://theuplift.world/
